text:
maria: Quick note  a support case showed onboarding failing: `400 invalid_tenant_label`. Our examples still use `team_alpha` in a couple spots. We should standardize to kebab-case and add validation.
ben: agree. i'll open a docs PR to replace examples and add a troubleshooting blurb.
josh: backend allows only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (3-64 chars). add regex and a tiny client-side validator.
emily: SDK bug: python helper silently converts underscores to hyphens in one path; filed RED-7654. docs should warn until SDK patch lands.
maria: pasted support log (redacted): `POST /v1/dedicated/tenants 400 {"error":"invalid_tenant_label"}`
ben: PR plan: replace labels, add JS and Python validator snippets, add troubleshooting entry and mention SDK issue. Draft PR: https://git.internal/rw/docs/pulls/5901 (WIP).
josh: include one-liner that telemetry lowercases labels.
sev_ops_bot: checklist: reference SDK issue in PR and add follow-up to remove warning post-patch.
maria: Action items: Ben  finish PR; Emily  post SDK PR link when ready; Josh  add telemetry note; Maria  remove warning after SDK fix.
ben: will update here when draft is ready. :rocket:
